sources.summary: We are excited to announce our first ever East Asia Symposium, hosted by AIA South Korea in Seoul! When: Friday 16 October - Saturday 17 October Where: Cociety (Day 1) + City tours (Day 2), Seoul, South Korea Event Description You are invited to Seoul for the East Asia Symposium! This collaborative project is hosted by AIA South Korea and supported by AIA Chapters, Sections and members across the region, including from Japan, Hong Kong and Taipei.
